EC1: - Hypersensitivity to ceftriaxone [OR] or cefotaxime, to another cephalosporin or to any of the excipients of the specialities concerned.
EC2: - History of severe hypersensitivity (e.g., anaphylactic reaction) to another class of antibacterial agent of the beta-lactam family (penicillins, [OR] monobactams [OR] and carbapenes)
EC5: - Suspicion of Pseudomonas infection [OR] or documented Pseudomonas infection requiring ceftazidime treatment
EC6: - Suspicion of group III enterobacteriaceae infection [OR] or group III enterobacteriaceae infection requiring cefepime treatment
